message: Documentation-only for this kind: the guard script builds all operator-facing prose itself (weakening_guard.py is the single home of the two-tier semantics — this string is never rendered into a finding). Two tiers (eADR-0040): a killswitch-tier change (a supply-chain repoint, a check demotion, a gate removal, the guard's own machinery) blocks the merge until the operator applies the `guardrail-ack` label, which downgrades the finding to a record rather than erasing it; every other guarded modification emits a plain-language non-blocking disclosure. The guard runs from the trusted main branch and reads only the change, never the pull request's own copy of the code, so a pull request cannot turn off the guard that judges it. It joins no suite (it is invoked by id from its own workflow), which keeps that property; do not move it into the merge-gating suite.
